$comment: Page discovery (Phase 2). heuristicPaths are probed on the brand's origin; sitemap URLs are kept only when their path (locale prefix removed) contains one of sitemapKeywords. Higher keyword weight = fetched earlier. Limits bound the work done per brand. sustainabilityKeywords decide which pages count as sustainability-type pages. ranking: each path segment beyond the first costs depthPenalty points, and at most maxPerSection URLs are kept under one first path segment (e.g. /stories/...), so a blog cannot crowd out the brand's own policy pages.
